title: Preparation
instructions: Connect assembly to test fixtures.
Verify all tubing and fittings are connected and sealed.
Zero all sensors.

title: Test 1 — CDA 1
instructions: Turn on CDA and V4.
Wait 1 minute for fill, then release CDA fitting.
Monitor QDF6, QDM14, QDF2 and QDF4.
Wait 1 minute for settling, then record initial readings.
Wait at least 1 minute, then record final readings.
cleanup: Release air and flip V21 to clear air in the system.

title: Test 2 — CDA 2
instructions: Turn on CDA and V4.
Toggle V26 and monitor QDM14.
Confirm QDM14 goes to zero with V26 on.

fields.label: QDM14 reaches zero with V26 on

cleanup: Release air and flip V21 to clear air in the system.

title: Test 3 — CDA 3
instructions: Turn on CDA, V4 and V21.
Wait 1 minute for fill, then release CDA fitting.
Monitor QDF18 and QDM7.
Wait 1 minute for settling, then record initial readings.
Wait at least 1 minute, then record final readings.
cleanup: Release air and flip V21 to clear air in the system.

title: ER1 — Pre-calibration
instructions: Turn on CDA, V4 and ER1.
Wait for readings to settle. Record the original R5 value from CV5 before calibration.
Calibrate if necessary. Suggested target: 3.0 psi; acceptable test range: 2.5–3.75 psi.
Clear air and reset by turning on CDA, V4 and ER1.
The next screen records readings after calibration during the decay test.

title: Test 4 — ER1 decay
instructions: Verify the CV5 reading reflects calibration. Acceptable CV5 range: 2.5–3.75 psi.
Wait 1 minute for fill, then release CDA fitting.
Monitor CV5, QDM5 and QDF22.
Wait 1 minute for settling, then record initial readings.
Wait at least 1 minute, then record final readings.
cleanup: Release air and flip V21 to clear air in the system.

title: Test 4.5 — CV3 / ER1
instructions: Switch CV5 sensor tubing to the 3-way valve.
Turn on CDA, V4 and ER1.
Record CV5 pressure: greater than 0 and less than 1.20 psi.
Check CV3 release for airflow.
Close and open the valve; verify CV5 returns to a stable state.
cleanup: Release air and flip V21 to clear air in the system.

title: Test 5 — Vac 1
instructions: Turn on Vac and V12. Power ER2 from the 24 V supply.
Wait 1 minute for fill, then turn Vac off.
Monitor QDF3.
Wait 1 minute for settling, then record initial reading.
Wait at least 1 minute, then record final reading. Use signed negative vacuum values.
cleanup: Flip V7 on and V12 off. Turn off ER2 power supply. Wait for pressure to equalize, then turn V7 off. Verify QDF3, QDM1 and QDF19 are zero.

title: Test 6 — Vac 2
instructions: Turn on Vac, V12 and V7. Power ER2 from the 24 V supply.
Apply ER2 control voltages in order: 1, 3, 5, 8 and 10 V.
At each voltage, wait for QDM1 and QDF19 to equalize and record both readings.
Use signed negative vacuum values. Return to 0 V and confirm vacuum drops to zero.

fields.label: Vacuum returns to zero at 0 V

cleanup: Flip V7 on and V12 off. Turn off ER2 power supply. Wait for pressure to equalize, then turn V7 off. Verify QDF3, QDM1 and QDF19 are zero.
